release_notes:
Clearer PayPal checkout fee breakdown for physical card orders

PayPal checkout for physical prepaid-card purchases now shows the processing fee honestly: a "Shipping" charge (fixed, same for every order size) and a "Handling" charge (scales with the order), instead of lumping everything into a misleading "Sales Tax" line.

The order total shown before checkout now correctly includes this fee — previously it could undercount the total on larger purchases. The new fee only applies to PayPal, never Stripe or other payment methods.
